$schema_note: Metafield definitions for Phase 9 Admin API/GraphQL setup. See docs/SHOPIFY_FOUNDATION.md for rationale.

definitions.name: Brand
definitions.purpose: Links a product to its rich brand content metaobject. Fast-follow per ADR-006 - not populated until the brand metaobject layer is built after Phase 7.

definitions.name: Included Items
definitions.purpose: Populated only for combo/bundle products (product.combo-deal.json template). Powers the 'what's included' block.

definitions.name: Legacy WooCommerce ID
definitions.purpose: Original WooCommerce post_id/user ID, kept for support/audit traceability during and after cutover.
